Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City OFFICE OF THE UNDERSECRETARY FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT blLG OPINION NO.J4 S. 18 February 2010 MAYOR CELERINO A. ENDAYA Cuenca, Batangas Dear Mayor Endaya: 2010 This has reference to your earlier letter asking our legal opinion on whether or not you may legally ignore the ongoing review of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan over Municipal Resolution No. 2010-06 entitled: 'Resolution Ratifying the Contract Entered into by the Municipa/ Mayor, Hon. Ce/erino A. Endaya and Mr. Manuel L. Santos of Ithie/ Corporation Regarding the Development, Operation and Management of Cuenca Public Market Based on a Long Term Lease Method. " In reply thereto, we answer in the affirmative. Please be informed that we concur with your view that the review authority of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan does not extend to Municipal Resolution No. 2010-06 which ratifies the contract which you, as the local executive of that municipality, has previously entered. In this regard, may we invite your attention to Section 56 (a) of the Local Government Code of 1991, thus: "SECTION 56. Review of Component City and Municipal Ordinances or Resolutions by the Sangguniang Panlalawigan Within three (3) days after approval, the secretary to the sangguniang panlungsod or sangguniang bayan shall forward to the sangguniang panlalawigan for review, copies of approved ordinances and the resolutions approving the local development plans and public investment programs formulated by the local development councils. " Based on the aforequoted provision, the authority of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan to review the acts of its component municipalities is limited to reviewing only (1) ordinances, and (2) resolutions approving local development pléns and public investment programs.. Hence, the submission of the subject municipal resolution to the Sangguniang Panlalawigan for review is not anymore necessary as it is not even a legal requirement under the Local Government Code of 1991. Accordingly, in the event that the Sangguniang Panlalawigan shall insist on reviewing the said

Municipal Resolution, the same will produce no legal force and effect since such review is not legally required by the Code. We hope that we have addressed your concern accordingly. Very truly yours, AUSTERE A. PANADER Undersecretary (/ copy furnished: RD JOSEFINA E. CASTILLA-GO DILG-Region iV-A MLGOO AUGUSTO L. MAULEON Cuenca, Batangas Legal/17
